tools.name: make_shape_collage
tools.description: Builds a photo collage in the shape of a heart, a number (age, anniversary, year), a word, a star, a flower and more from the user's photos, and returns a watermarked preview within seconds. Use when the user asks for a heart collage, a birthday/anniversary number collage, a 'photo collage in the sh

tools.name: get_shape_collage
tools.description: Returns the status and the watermarked preview of a collage made with make_shape_collage, by its id (clg_...). Use when make_shape_collage answered status "processing", or to show the collage again.

tools.name: list_collage_shapes
tools.description: Shows the menu of Collager.ai photo collages with a real example: the shapes make_shape_collage can draw (hearts of 27-164 photos, numbers, words, I love you, circle, star, flower, grid, your own mask) and how many photos fill each without repeats. Call it first when the user only mentions Collager.

tools.name: plan_shape_collage
tools.description: Shows the plan of the photo collage the user picked (shape, how many photos it holds, background) with a real example, and how to attach the photos. Use it when the user has chosen a shape but has not attached the photos yet. After the user attaches the photos or shares links, call make_shape_collag

tools.name: list_mosaic_styles
tools.description: Shows the looks of a Collager.ai photo mosaic (one large picture made of hundreds or thousands of small photos) with example images: soft classic, clean subject, stronger mosaic, uniform or mixed tile sizes. Use before start_photo_mosaic when the user wants to choose a style.

tools.name: start_photo_mosaic
tools.description: Gives the link where the user builds a photo mosaic: one main photo recreated from many small photos (best with 100-2000 photos - family archive, wedding, team, school year).
